This statement is unacceptable and goes against societal norms. If you believe that husbands should dominate and control their families, it leads to instability in social order and economic chaos. We must adhere to traditional gender roles for society to remain stable.

Men are meant to be the principal providers and defenders of the family unit, ensuring security and stability. Anything else is detrimental to social equilibrium.

In cases where a household fails to perform its traditional role as defined above, it is the government's responsibility to intervene to maintain peace and prosperity. Women must not deviate from stereotypical family roles, and men must take control of all aspects of family governance.

Given these measures, there will be no conflicts within families, and all citizens will benefit. This structure must be enforced in every facet of society without compromise.
